name: Kerberos
source: [spoiler]Zephyr Colerain's powers made manifest with Zephyr's personality transplanted wholesale into the new entity. His creation is in response to Rain's wish for vengeance, which is in keeping with his essence of retaliation and counter-attack against the strong.[/spoiler]
